title: Requirements and open questions
summary: What the requester needs, in numbers, with the questions still open and who answers them.

title: Assumptions log
summary: Every assumption you made to keep moving, its impact if wrong, and who must confirm it.

title: KPI dictionary
summary: One entry per business measure: definition, formula, grain, owner, source and caveats.

title: Validation and reconciliation
summary: How you prove the numbers: source-to-report reconciliation, tests, tolerances and results.

title: UAT plan and log
summary: Test cases the business runs before go-live, with expected and actual results and an outcome per case.

title: RLS / OLS test matrix
summary: Every role and a representative user, what each must and must not see, and the result after each release.

title: Performance before/after report
summary: Baseline, root cause per visual, fix, measured improvement and the budget it now meets.

title: Architecture decision record (ADR)
summary: Context, constraints, options, decision, consequences, risks and the trigger to revisit.

title: Pull request description
summary: What changed, why, how it was tested, the risk and how to roll back.

title: Release notes and migration plan
summary: What changes for users and when, the steps, the checks and the rollback.

title: Deployment checklist
summary: Checks before and after promoting content between environments.

title: Runbook
summary: Step-by-step diagnosis and recovery for a known failure, written for whoever is on call.

title: Incident report
summary: The facts of an incident as it happens: impact, timeline, mitigation, status updates.

title: Blameless postmortem
summary: Why it happened, why it wasn't caught, and the actions that stop it happening again.

title: Data contract
summary: What a source team promises a consuming team: schema, meaning, freshness, quality and change notice.

title: Ownership matrix (RACI)
summary: Who is responsible, accountable, consulted and informed for each definition, model and process.
